subject: Continuity stipend proposal for stalled PO
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@mediflow.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: MediFlow Procurement <procurement@mediflow.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: keep sandbox live while PO processes

Hi Nikhil,

Quick note — our procurement team put the PO for Redwood Dedicated through on Friday but they flagged a legal review that pushed approval into next week. Our pilot sandbox is scheduled to expire on Tuesday (July 6) and the team really needs the environment for an executive demo on Thursday.

Is there any way Redwood can keep our demo/sandbox live or provide a short-term credit allocation while we finish approvals? We don't want to lose the progress we've built (and the exec demo matters for budget sign-off).

I've attached the draft PO so you can see where it is in the pipeline (mediflow_po_draft.pdf). Estimated clearance: July 9 per procurement.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Director of Product
MediFlow

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@mediflow.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep sandbox live while PO processes

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO.

We can help here. Two options that would keep your team constructive ahead of the exec demo:

- Fast continuity stipend: a one-time credit top-up equivalent to a 7-day sandbox run (we typically allocate this as a temporary token credit tied to your account) OR
- Short trial extension: keep the sandbox active for 7 days while the PO clears.

To proceed I need two quick things:
1) Confirm the exact date your demo needs the environment (you mentioned Thursday — is that July 8 or 9?).
2) Confirm the PO ETA per procurement (your note said July 9).

If you want, Camila (cc'd) can handle the technical handoff and put together the exact credit amount. We'll also send a short terms note for the stipend (no billing until PO clears).

I'll tentatively prepare a 7-day stipend assuming a July 8 exec demo — if procurement clears earlier we can reconcile.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@mediflow.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: MediFlow Procurement <procurement@mediflow.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep sandbox live while PO processes

Thanks, Nikhil — that would be great.

Confirmed: exec demo is July 8 (internal stakeholders), and procurement still expects firm sign-off by July 9. If you can guarantee the sandbox is available through July 9 we should be covered.

We prefer the continuity stipend so we can control usage; could you outline the proposed credit amount so procurement can note it internally? Also, procurement asked whether Redwood requires any temporary agreement or paper trail for this — I attached a short note with the PO for reference.

Attachment: mediflow_po_draft.pdf

Appreciate the quick help.

—Sarah

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Continuity stipend proposal for stalled PO

Camila — forwarding the thread. Procurement at MediFlow expects PO clearance by July 9 but they need the sandbox through July 8 for an exec demo. They asked for the stipend amount and any minimal paperwork.

My proposal: grant a one-time temporary stipend of $750 (applies to hosting/inference tokens only) — roughly covers a heavy three-day demo + 4 days of light usage. No billing until PO clears. We'll attach a one-paragraph terms stub (continuity_stipend_terms.txt) that says the credit is conditional on PO execution within 21 days and will be reconciled to the initial invoice.

Can you confirm you can provision the credit from our program fund and add the terms doc? If Grace can sign off on the $750 from the demo budget we can reply to Sarah and get procurement to ack the terms.

Thanks — want to keep the momentum here.
